headline: General Strike Friday, November 20 in Tuscany. Buses, Trams, Schools and Healthcare Stop. Hours and Guaranteed Services
summary: A 24-hour strike covering public and private sectors is set for Friday, November 20, in Tuscany. Buses, trams, schools and healthcare will stop, with possible disruption to trains and waste collection.
why: Strikes in Italy's public and private sectors disrupt transport, services and productivity, and they feed into labour relations and regional economic activity.
